description.tr: 1729'da ilk Osmanlı Türkçe matbaasını kuran Macar mühtedisi — kapanmadan önce 23 ciltte 17 eser (~12.700 kopya). Kâtip Çelebi'nin Cihannümâ'sını bastı ve hattat loncalarının muhalefetiyle karşılaştı || Kaynak materyali '23 ciltte 17 eser, ~12.700 kopya' ve 'hattat loncalarının muhalefeti' bilgisini verir. || [Tarih notu] Berkes (1962) Müteferrika'yı Osmanlı reform hareketleri bağlamına oturttu.
description.en: Hungarian convert who established the first Ottoman Turkish printing press in 1729 — producing 17 works in 23 volumes (~12,700 copies) before closure. Source material emphasizes he printed Katip Çelebi's Cihannüma and faced resistance from scribe guilds || Source material states '17 works in 23 volumes, ~12,700 copies' and notes 'scribe guilds' opposition' as a factor in the press's eventual closure. Müteferrika also wrote an important treatise on military reform. His press was the first to print in Ottoman Turkish — though Jewish and Christian presses had operated earlier. || [Historiographical note] Berkes (1962) contextualized Müteferrika within Ottoman reform movements. The 275-year gap between Gutenberg (1455) and the Ottoman press (1729) remains one of the most discussed questions in Ottoman cultural history.
